newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.027pts to 102.060.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.027pts to 102.060.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.027 points in Monday's trading to 102.060, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.008 points to 2.453 years.
The index can also be found on Reuters page .BICS.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.043 points to 98.494, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.008 points to 2.325 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 1.017 points to 1,094.094.
